methodology.timing: CI enforces deterministic allocation, copy, and complexity budgets; wall-clock timings are release evidence and are compared only with noise-tolerant policy.
methodology.host_model: Portable hosts without hardware acceleration exercise the wire, queue, command-engine, and reference-backend layers. Provider hooks add hardware evidence later without changing this artifact.
methodology.guest_counts: All allocation sizes derived from guest-controlled counts are bounded by validated device limits before reservation.

regression_policy.timing_threshold: A release job may compare median native-host timings against the checked-in baseline using a 15% warning threshold and a 30% failure threshold after five warmup iterations.
regression_policy.copy_threshold: Hidden direct-binding submission staging is always a failure; explicit transfer bytes are reported separately from accelerator execution.

operations.complexity: O(1) for scalar requests; O(d) descriptor validation before decode
operations.copy_profile: fixed prefix copies only; transfer and artifact tails remain borrowed byte regions

operations.complexity: O(b log b), where b is validated binding_count
operations.allocation_profile: one bounded decoded-binding vector after binding_count <= max_bindings_per_submission <= HARD_MAX_BINDINGS
operations.copy_profile: binding metadata only; no buffer range bytes are read or copied
operations.budget_exception: The portable decoder owns one bounded metadata vector for duplicate-slot validation; this is not provider staging and does not contain buffer contents.

operations.complexity: O(s + n), where s is segment count and n is requested bytes
operations.permitted_copy_boundary: explicit ByteSource::read_at or ByteSink::write_at caller request

operations.complexity: O(1) slot lookup plus generation/kind validation

operations.allocation_profile: inherits request decoder budget; creation paths reserve one bounded object-table slot before backend mutation
operations.copy_profile: response header/object payload copies only unless the opcode is an explicit transfer

operations.complexity: O(b log b + object lookups), including O(b) revalidation after canonical slot sorting
operations.allocation_profile: bounded event dependency storage and native binding metadata after decode validation; resolved buffer descriptors are validated in place without a mirror allocation; providers must not allocate hidden direct-binding bounce buffers
operations.copy_profile: metadata only; no full-range program-buffer copy

operations.complexity: O(contexts + buffers + programs + queues + events + retained event bindings)
operations.allocation_profile: zero new guest-count-derived allocations; releases existing owned state

operations.complexity: O(n + s), where n is explicit transfer bytes and s is segment count
operations.allocation_profile: bounded provider staging is allowed only inside read_buffer/write_buffer for device-local transfers
operations.copy_profile: explicit transfer bytes are counted separately from staged bytes and accelerator execution time
distinguishes direct, shared/imported, staged-direct, staged bytes, and explicit transfer bytes
